is_mandatory.quote: It is unlawful for any person to practice optometry unless he shall obtain a license to do so as provided in this chapter.

title_protection.quote: by any means or method set oneself forth as an optometrist, doctor of optometry, optometric physician, optical doctor, doctor of optical science, O.D., Opt. D., optician, optical specialist, eye specialist, or refractionist

scope_protection.quote: Any person who shall practice or attempt to practice optometry, as defined in this chapter, without having at the time of so doing a valid license to practice optometry issued by the state board of optometry shall be deemed guilty of a misdemeanor.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Fraud or deception in procuring a license
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Fraud or deception in procuring license.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Practicing optometry under a false or assumed name or as a representative of an unauthorized entity
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Practicing optometry under a false or assumed name or as a representative or agent of any person, firm or corporation other than another licensed optometrist

disciplinary_grounds.description: Conviction of a crime deemed relevant to optometric qualifications or duties
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Having been convicted or having received a withheld judgment or suspended sentence in this or any other state of a crime that is deemed relevant in accordance with section 67-9411(1), Idaho Code, or any act related to the qualifications, functions or duties of an optometrist.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Gross incompetency in the practice of optometry
Inability to practice optometry with reasonable skill and safety due to mental illness, physical illness, substance abuse, or communicable disease
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Inability to practice optometry with reasonable skill and safety by reason of: (a) Mental illness; (b) Physical illness including, but not limited to, physical deterioration which adversely affects cognitive, motor or perceptive skills; (c) Habitual or excessive use or abuse of drugs defined in law as controlled substances, alcohol, or any other substances which impair ability; or (d) Having a communicable, contagious or infectious disease which endangers the health of patients.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to pay the annual renewal fee and secure a renewal license
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failure to pay to the board or the division of occupational and professional licenses the annual fee and to secure a renewal license

disciplinary_grounds.description: Any practice or behavior likely to deceive or defraud the public
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Any practice or behavior of a character likely to deceive or defraud the public.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Obtaining any fee or compensation by fraud, deceit, or misrepresentation
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Obtaining of any fee or compensation by fraud, deceit or misrepresentation.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Employing a suspended or unlicensed optometrist to perform optometric work
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Employing, either directly or indirectly, any suspended or unlicensed optometrist to do optometric work.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Advertising the practice of optometry in a false, misleading, or deceptive manner
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Advertising the practice of optometry in a false, misleading or deceptive manner.
Employment or use of what are known as "cappers" or "steerers."

disciplinary_grounds.description: Consistently accepting referrals that violate Idaho law
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Consistently accepting referrals that violate the laws of the state of Idaho.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Willfully permitting an unlicensed person to use the optometrist's prescription to fit contact lenses
disciplinary_grounds.quote: For willfully permitting or allowing or causing a person who is not a licensed optometrist or a licensed physician or surgeon to use the optometrist's prescription or optometric finding to fit contact lenses upon a person or member of the public.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violation of any provision of the optometry chapter or board rules or code of ethics
disciplinary_grounds.quote: For violation of any of the provisions of this chapter or the rules or code of ethics made and promulgated by the state board of optometry

disciplinary_grounds.description: Willfully attempting to violate, conspiring to violate, or assisting in violation of the chapter or board rules
disciplinary_grounds.quote: For willfully attempting to violate, directly or indirectly, conspiring to violate, or assisting or participating in or abetting the violation of any of the provisions of this chapter or the rules or code of ethics

disciplinary_grounds.description: Conduct constituting abuse or exploitation of a patient arising from the trust placed in the licensee
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Having engaged in any conduct which constitutes an abuse or exploitation of a patient arising out of the trust and confidence placed in the licensee by the patient.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Having committed any act that constitutes a crime deemed relevant under Idaho Code
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Having committed any act that constitutes a crime that is deemed relevant in accordance with section 67-9411(1), Idaho Code.

definition_quote.value: Optometry is defined as the science which relates to the examination, diagnosis and treatment of conditions of or relating to the eyes and/or eyelids, the analysis of their function and the employment of preventive or corrective measures to ensure maximum vision and comfort.
definition_quote.quote: Optometry is defined as the science which relates to the examination, diagnosis and treatment of conditions of or relating to the eyes and/or eyelids, the analysis of their function and the employment of preventive or corrective measures to ensure maximum vision and comfort.

value: examining, testing, measuring, treating, correcting, developing or improving the human visual apparatus
use of diagnostic pharmaceutical agents and pharmaceutical agents for therapeutic use
diagnosis and treatment of superficial conditions of the eye and eyelid
prescribing or adapting lenses including contact lenses

methods_authorized.quote: To employ in the examination, diagnosis or treatment of another, any means, including the use of diagnostic pharmaceutical agents and pharmaceutical agents for therapeutic use, for the measurement, improvement or development of any or all functions of human vision

drug_authority.value: May prescribe, administer and dispense therapeutic pharmaceutical agents for treatment of conditions of the eye and/or eyelid upon issuance of a certificate by the state board of optometry; diagnostic pharmaceutical agents also authorized.
drug_authority.quote: the state board of optometry may, pursuant to rules adopted by it, issue a certificate to optometrists licensed in this state authorizing the optometrist to prescribe, administer and dispense such therapeutic pharmaceutical agents for the treatment of conditions of the eye and/or eyelid

surgery_prohibited.quote: The practice of optometry shall not include the use of therapeutic lasers

foreign_body_removal_authorized.quote: To remove superficial foreign bodies and to diagnose and treat superficial conditions of the eye and eyelid.
